title: A new phone plan
instructions: Mia telefon mağazasında tarife seçiyor. Uzun bir diyalog; tarifeleri ve neyin dahil olduğunu karıştırma.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Hi. I'd like to change my phone plan. I'm paying too much.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Sure. How do you use your phone? Do you make a lot of calls?

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Not really. I mostly use the internet and send messages.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then we have two good plans. The Basic plan is ten pounds a month with five gigabytes of data.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Five isn't enough. I watch a lot of videos.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The Plus plan is eighteen pounds a month with unlimited data and free calls.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, for twelve months. But if you choose twenty-four months, it's only fifteen pounds a month.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Hmm, I don't want a long contract. I might move abroad next year.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Then twelve months is better for you.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: OK, I'll take the Plus plan for twelve months.

questions.prompt: How does Mia mostly use her phone?
questions.feedback: Çoğunlukla internet ve mesaj için kullanıyor.
questions.evidence: I mostly use the internet and send messages.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Mia choose the Basic plan?
questions.feedback: Çok video izliyor; beş gigabayt yetmiyor.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Mia want a 24-month contract?
questions.evidence: I might move abroad next year.

questions.prompt: How much will Mia pay per month?
questions.feedback: Plus tarifesi on iki ay için ayda on sekiz pound.
questions.evidence: OK, I'll take the Plus plan for twelve months.
